thesis: The speaker recounts his career progression from management consulting to asset management consulting, which led to a unique opportunity to join a client and start an alternatives business with a private equity firm just before the financial crisis. He explains that recognizing the emerging cracks in the credit crisis during that period prompted him to launch Gapstow Capital Partners in 2009 as a niche firm focused on institutional credit.
